QuestInfo.name: [Kin] The Second Path of the Kin
QuestInfo.0: Radiant Hua, one of the Kin, wants to give you your second assignment to become true member of the Kin.
QuestInfo.1:
To prove that you have the skills to rank up in the Kin, you need to collect #b10 Intermediate Kinship Symbols#k. 

#rTip!#k Intermediate Kinship Symbols can be acquired from the following monsters:
- Mystic Gate: #rMaster Hoblin, Master Harp, Manon, Griffey, Kentaurus King, Timer, Riche, King Sage Cat, King Centipede, Papulatus#k
- Boss: #rNormal Zakum, Easy Horntail, Normal Horntail#k
QuestInfo.2: You have proven to Radiant Hua that you have what it takes to rank up in the Kin. Radiant Hua has given you the #b#t3700152##k title and a #b#t1114000##k as a reward.

0.0: Hey, you look like you're ready for the next rank of Kin-shipness. I made that word up... for LOVE. You ready to upgrade your Kin rank?

yes.0: Bring me #i4033801##b #t4033801##k x10 to prove that you're bursting with love and truth.
yes.1:
Get #b#t4033801##k items from #rMystic Gates#k scattered throughout Maple World and from #rsome boss monsters#k. The monsters you need to hunt are...

- Mystic Gate: #rMaster Hoblin, Master Harp, Manon, Griffey, Kentaurus King, Timer, Riche, King Sage Cat, King Centipede, Papulatus#k
- Boss: #rNormal Zakum, Easy Horntail, Normal Horntail#k
yes.2: Got it? May love, joy, peace, and happiness be on your side! Rawr!

no.0: Come on! Do it for love!\r\n
